model_output.verdict: An experienced accountant with solid accounts payable detail and one standout closing improvement.
write_up: You show accounting experience in Vietnam and US accounts payable work, including around 400 vendor invoices a month in QuickBooks. A recruiter can see the work, but your part in the current month-end close is still a blank.

The best line is the closing improvement: 12 days to 7, using a new checklist and template. Give the team leadership line the same concrete treatment, and polish the phrasing throughout so the accounting work doesn't have to compete with grammar.
